aiResearchSummary.text: Keenon Robotics is engaged in developing commercial service robots with a focus on map construction, delivery control, and collision avoidance. Their work includes a map construction method for robots using lidar and radar probes to determine reference point clouds, a control method for delivery robots that identifies and manages obstructions in distribution areas, and a collision avoidance method for moving devices that determines target path directions and adjusts navigation accordingly. These areas define their research and development efforts.
